raw_segments.text: He has not yet lost the habits of his erratic life.
The traditions of his fathers and his passion for the chase are still alive within him.
The wild enjoyments which formerly animated him in the woods painfully excite his troubled
imagination and his former privations appear to be less keen, his former perils less appalling.
He contrasts the independence which he possessed amongst his equals with the serval position
which he occupies in civilized society.
On the other hand, the solitudes which were so long his free home are still at hand.
A few hours march will bring him back to them once more.
